exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb ta hou ga ii".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 動詞たほうがいい matches "Verb ta hou ga ii".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 動詞たほうがいい.
exercises.explanation: Gives advice or suggestions using the verb's past (ta) form plus ほうがいい.
